class.name: TamaBulletRegistry
class.brief_description: A Resource that maps bullet type names to scenes and server configs.
class.description:
[b]TamaBulletRegistry[/b] holds the full set of bullet types known to Tama. It can be configured imperatively via [TamaManager] methods, or assembled as a [Resource] asset and assigned to [method TamaManager.set_registry].
[b]scene_bullets[/b] maps type name strings to [PackedScene] resources for scene-based bullets.
[b]server_bullets[/b] maps type name strings to [TamaServerBulletConfig] resources for server (MultiMesh) bullets.
When a TamaScript fires a bullet whose type is not found in either dictionary, the fallback used depends on [member default_to_server_bullets]: if [code]false[/code] (default), [member default_scene_bullet] is used; if [code]true[/code], [member default_server_bullet] is used instead.

method.name: get_server_config
method.description: Returns the [TamaServerBulletConfig] registered under [param type], or [code]null[/code] if none is found.

members.member: Fallback scene used when a bullet type fired by a TamaScript is not found in [member scene_bullets] and [member default_to_server_bullets] is [code]false[/code].
Fallback server bullet config used when a bullet type is not found and [member default_to_server_bullets] is [code]true[/code].
Maps bullet type names ([String]) to [PackedScene] resources. Used for scene-based bullets.
Maps bullet type names ([String]) to [TamaServerBulletConfig] resources. Used for server bullets.

When [code]true[/code], bullets with no type or an unrecognised type fall back to [member default_server_bullet] instead of [member default_scene_bullet]. Has no effect if [member default_server_bullet] is not set.
